authority: Existing user-authorized bounded smoke tests and meaningful negative controls
runtime_libraries: Copy exactly ggml-base.dll, ggml-cpu.dll, ggml-rpc.dll, ggml-vulkan.dll and ggml.dll from original pinned build/bin to a new owned runtime folder; record each source and copied SHA-256 and verify before/after. No executable-directory or global PATH mutation.
source_review: Seven fixed tiny matrix layouts; explicit selected Vulkan backend, no scheduler/CPU graph, checked buffer ownership/support/allocation limits, independent double reference, full-output finite/error checks. Only bounded tensors, no model download/load. Existing driver/pipeline allocations cannot be hard-limited by public API.
purpose: Before-patch RED control; numerical FAIL is expected for precision-discriminating noncontiguous cases and must remain a failure result, not a passing workload.
guards: Exact source/executable/runtime pins before and after
Retained hidden owned process, no shell, monotonic deadline and bounded concurrent stream drains
Stop on timeout, corruption of pins, native crash, ownership/unsupported refusal or malformed output; no unchanged retry
No subsequent corruption or different-device run admitted by this receipt
limits: No direct peer access or capacity/residency proof
